name: Acronis
description: Docker image of Acronis Backup Agent 12.5.12960 installed on Centos 7 x64 In order to get a registration token you need to go to Acronis Cyber Cloud > Devices > Add (top right) then "Registration Token" area in the bottom and then "Generate" from there. To register, console into the container and run ./register_mms.sh -o register -a YOURDATACENTERURL --token TOKEN -t cloud NOTE: If you ever have to do a force update or rebuild your docker.img this will need to be re-registered! Limitations 1. Updating the agent running inside a container via Acronis web console interface from Settings -> Agents is not supported. The container should be updated separately if a new version ever comes out. 2. To back up data from NAS device only Files/Folders backup type should be used. Entire machine or Disks/volumes backup type is not supported. 3. This is a very old agent, I do not manage or update this image, it's from Acronis themselves and they seem to have abandoned this container.
